observations: Front view of a white LG washing machine.
Brand 'LG' and 'DirectDrive 7kg' are clearly printed on the top left of the control panel in photo 0.
A green sticker on the left side of the machine lists 'Less Noise', 'Less Vibration', and 'More Durability'.
The control panel features a large rotary dial and several push buttons.
A digital display is visible on the right side of the panel.
The machine shows significant surface wear, dirt, and some rust stains on the lower front panel.
A '10 YEAR WARRANTY' sticker is visible on the right side of the machine in photo 0.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or may have a faulty motor.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine running through all cycles.

risks.risk: The internal drum may be damaged or have a leak.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine emptying and the drum being cleaned.

risks.risk: The internal drum may be rusted or have a broken seal.
risks.proof: A video showing the drum being spun and the interior being inspected.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine powered on and running through all cycles.
Video showing the drum being spun and the interior being cleaned.
Photo of the manufacturer's label on the back of the machine.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as an LG DirectDrive 7kg washing machine from the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case (non-working) until proof of operation is provided.
